findings.title: Closing the modal without clicking the Close button leaves 2FA UI state out of sync and does not reset form state
findings.body:
In `handleEnable`, once `TwoFactorAuthAPI.enable(totpCode)` returns HTTP 200, 2FA is already enabled on the server, but the component now transitions to `SetupStep.DisplayBackupCodes` (line 135) and defers calling `onEnable()` and `resetState()` until the user clicks the `backup-codes-close` button (lines 266–270).

1. If the user dismisses the dialog on the `DisplayBackupCodes` step via Escape, clicking the backdrop, or the dialog close button (`onOpenChange` on line 166), `onEnable()` is never called. The parent page never updates its state, leaving the 2FA toggle switch unchecked even though 2FA is active on the account.
2. `resetState()` (lines 71–75) does not clear the `totpCode` field in `form` (`form.reset()` / `form.setValue("totpCode", "")`). If the user disables 2FA and opens the modal again without reloading the page (or cancels after entering a code), `form.watch("totpCode")` retains the previous 6-digit value, which triggers the auto-submit `useEffect` on lines 157–161.

findings.title: First 2FA E2E test leaves the backup codes modal open and relies on an unawaited Promise assertion
findings.body: In the first test (`"should allow a user to enable 2FA and login using 2FA"`), after `fillOtp` submits the valid TOTP code on line 44, the modal now advances to the backup codes screen (`SetupStep.DisplayBackupCodes`) rather than closing and calling `onEnable()`. Because this test does not click `[data-testid="backup-codes-close"]` (unlike the second test at line 125), `onEnable()` is never called and `[data-testid=two-factor-switch]` remains unchecked, as noted in the `FIXME` comment. Line 53 (`await expect(page.locator("[data-testid=two-factor-switch]").isChecked()).toBeTruthy()`) only passes because `isChecked()` returns a `Promise<boolean>` that is not awaited before being passed to `expect()`, and a `Promise` object is always truthy. The step should close the backup codes modal (or `onEnable` should be called when the enable API succeeds) and assert `[data-testid=two-factor-switch][data-state="checked"]`.
